sourceInformation.perspective: First-person fixed 3D operating field; cinematic character scenes
sourceInformation.tech: JavaScript ES modules; unmodified Pixel Engine 0.46.0 (three.js r186, embedded Rapier); esbuild 0.28.2. Fully embedded single HTML.
sourceInformation.artDirection: Native low-poly 3D pixel art with original procedural anatomy, surgical instruments, hands, six character portraits and seven hospital sets; Kenney furniture props.
sourceInformation.animation: Native HERO_CLIPS on custom rigs, SpringChain and Squash; procedural tools, blinking, mouths, breathing, heartbeat, perfusion and ghost hands.
sourceInformation.audio: Original chiptune songs, instrument and monitor effects, and formant-synthesised gibberish voices, all generated in JavaScript. No audio assets; music defaults to 10%.
sourceInformation.online: AI Hub v1 shared-world Consult for 1-4 players, client 1.4.0; authoritative host/server, compact snapshots and remote interpolation. Standalone couch Consult for 1-4.
sourceInformation.testing: Full campaign to credits; tool/save rules; audio/analyser; mouse, keyboard and pad stubs; 14 viewports; 5 Hub scenarios. WebKit/Firefox fallback checked; real iOS Safari and physical pads unavailable.
sourceInformation.research: Planner reported source Wikipedia, Hub and engine spikes. Build research read PLAN.md, engine GUIDE/ASSETS/API, the engine release and official Hub protocol.

testingFeedback: 16 distinct issues caught and fixed, grouping repeated model warnings by their root cause; details are recorded in tests/ISSUES.md.
5 runtime, progression or multiplayer blockers; one additional packaging blocker. All are fixed.
The complete engine-driven campaign playthrough verified every scene and operation through credits, saves and unlocks. Separate-pad browser play caught a control-routing defect.
The short boot replay checked engine setup but did not expose gesture, controller-routing or visual layout problems.
engineFeedback: The native 3D-to-pixel renderer, declarative models, animation clips, procedural audio and headless replay work together through one import.
I initially omitted cameraTarget and underestimated curved-surface picking and visibility semantics; engine checks and browser tests exposed those assumptions.
A deterministic, rewindable surgical simulation with eight tool gestures, a campaign, a reusable bot and an authoritative shared world.
Coordinating curved anatomy, precise mouse picking, the retained pixel HUD, and independent controller seats.
none; pixel-engine.js is byte-identical to the shipping archive. All game systems and assets were added on top.

promptFeedback: The original cast, patient hooks and verified engine recipes gave the game a concrete identity and a useful starting point.
The boundary between a feature-complete demo and the proposed ten-operation campaign was unclear; I implemented all ten linked cases.
Keeping precise surgical gestures, multiple input devices, time rewind and shared-state play coherent while preserving the drama.
State the required campaign length in TASK.md as well as in the plan.

aiHub.name: Trauma Ward: Critical Opinion
aiHub.description: A rain-soaked surgical drama in Port Verity. Trace incisions, extract foreign bodies, face engineered pathogens and bring your patients home through ten operations or a shared Consult shift.
aiHub.controls: Stick / WASD / mouse: aim; R2 / J / click: use; right stick / 1–8: tools; L2 / Space: gift; Options / Esc: pause.
